issue.description:
Guard automatic Git staging and sync commit against durable recovery quarantine under research/specs/secret-write-boundary-v1.md section 4.

Acceptance criteria:
- While quarantined, automatic staging and sync commit return the redacted secret_quarantined result and leave both the Git index and HEAD unchanged.
- Once audited redaction has verified a sanitized generation set and cleared quarantine, normal staging and sync commit can proceed.
- Synthetic tests cover refusal, unchanged index/HEAD, successful post-redaction commit, and redacted output with no matched bytes.
issue.notes: Benefit: recovery quarantine now has explicit Git-boundary conformance coverage, proving no automatic staging or sync commit can publish quarantined checkpoint bytes. Implemented committed test tests/quarantine_git_publication.rs: runtime-assembled synthetic credential, unrelated staged index entry, direct automatic-staging refusal, sync commit refusal, unchanged index and HEAD, redacted secret_quarantined output with no matched bytes, audited --all-blocking redaction, and successful post-redaction sync commit while preserving unrelated staging. Source guards were verified at both staging and sync-commit seams. Verification: cargo fmt --check passed; scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast passed from clean git archive HEAD; cargo test --test quarantine_git_publication passed in that same clean archive; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passed from a clean git archive HEAD. Commit: 7c1c784e887d9d15faff7a853b7aa2ef0c581d55.
issue.title: Withhold Sync Commit Staging Until Quarantine Clears
